svg.aria-label: Ways to install: PowerShell's one line, Scoop, by hand, or an administrator's install for a standard user. Each gives one folder on PATH: wsl-spawner.exe, the Windows program, runs in PowerShell and Windows Terminal; wsl-spawner, the launcher, inside WSL; wsl-spawnerw.exe, the same with no window, at sign-in and sign-out.
